headline: Going Commando links C switch tables and publishes a catch-up progress report
summary: Going Commando can now link verified compiler-generated switch tables, allowing five C functions in #312 and three more in #313 to enter the build. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The progress refresh in #310 raises USA v1.01 from 12.99% to 14.04% matched code, with 4,351 of 8,601 functions, including previously unreported merges. It separately puts USA v2.00 at 13.13% and 4,149 of 8,655 functions, and Europe/Australia at 10.16% and 3,666 of 8,693, before the day's later merges.
highlights: #309 contributes 62 newly matched routines across the releases that contain them. Its much larger source diff also includes retained reconstructions that do not count as matches.
Another 15 game functions land in #311, with useful near misses kept outside the linked build.
Checking actual switch destinations catches wrong case mappings in two Joba reconstructions, which are corrected in #313.
The 89 C reconstructions in #308 remain unlinked and add no matching credit.
